concept: AWS Config: automatic remediation via SSM Automation
tests: Knowing how to automatically fix resources flagged non-compliant by a Config rule.
expected: A Config remediation action with an SSM Automation document (e.g., enable bucket encryption). Triggers: "non-compliant", "fixed automatically", "Config rule".
why_not: A composite alarm only aggregates alarms; CloudTrail data events log object access; high-resolution metrics are about metric granularity.
